Analyze Missing Data Patterns

Source: R/missing.R
missing_analysis.Rd

Provides comprehensive missing data analysis including patterns, Little's MCAR test, and visualizations.

Usage

missing_analysis(
  data,
  Vars = NULL,
  pattern_plot = TRUE,
  mcar_test = TRUE,
  correlations = FALSE,
  digits = 2
)

Arguments

data

A data frame to analyze.

Vars

Character vector of variable names. If NULL (default), all variables are included.

pattern_plot

Logical. Create missing data pattern visualization? Default TRUE.

mcar_test

Logical. Perform Little's MCAR test? Default TRUE.

correlations

Logical. Show correlations between missingness indicators? Default FALSE.

digits

Integer. Number of decimal places. Default 2.

Value

A list containing:

  • summary: gt table with missing data summary

  • patterns: Data frame of missing patterns

  • mcar: MCAR test results (if requested)

  • plot: Missing pattern plot (if requested)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Create data with missing values
df <- mtcars
df$mpg[c(1, 5, 10)] <- NA
df$hp[c(2, 5, 15)] <- NA

missing_analysis(df)
} # }
